MRI Information
MR Conditional (1.5T only): slew rate ≤ 100 T/m/s per axis; maximum B1+rms of 2.4 microtesla; Normal Operating Mode.
Image artifact: up to 2 mm.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
